working_tree: Uncommitted changes; no tests added to the suite. New cases were run as a manual audit.

findings_fixed.title: Whitespace-only optional cells treated as unresolved identifiers
findings_fixed.evidence: 7967 stops contain a single space in parent_station; original generation reports unknown stop ID ' '.
findings_fixed.fix: Whitespace-only cells are absent values; non-blank IDs and leading zeroes remain unchanged. Blank required fields still fail validation.
findings_fixed.verification: All 15 sampled HSL routes generate, retain selection semantics, and survive report roundtrip without caller normalisation.

findings_fixed.title: Extended route types excluded by mode filtering
findings_fixed.evidence: After a caller-side blank-cell normalisation control, nine sampled routes with route_type 701, 702, 704, 900 or 109 failed their corresponding mode selection.
findings_fixed.fix: Both loaders match published extended types to their corresponding basic mode; generated routes retain original numeric codes.
findings_fixed.verification: Actual HSL mode cases pass; nine OSM supplemental mode cases cover all eight supported modes and coaches.

findings_fixed.title: Recognised extended rail and tram types used the generic speed
findings_fixed.source: HSL official GTFS with timing offsets deliberately omitted
findings_fixed.evidence: route_type 109 and 900 previously reached the other=20 km/h fallback.
findings_fixed.fix: Mode selection and default speed resolution share one registry mapping. Existing explicit timings and global speed overrides retain precedence.
findings_fixed.verification: Suburban rail 109 uses 60 km/h and tram 900 uses 25 km/h; 17 untimed reference-route cases pass, retaining original route_type values.

acquisition.policy: Regional Overpass for Europe. Elsewhere, small OSM API map queries followed by complete selected route and parent-relation reads. Way coordinates expanded losslessly from node references.
acquisition.overture_policy: Actual segment/connector data downloaded for twelve small bounding boxes, then replayed for deterministic public-loader checks.

manual_harness_corrections: Added the HSL 704 bus code to the audit lookup, allowing the library behaviour to be checked.
Deferred two BART mode checks until their actual Overture snapshot was available.
Converted reference coordinate columns to numbers before calculating BART bounds; the initial audit used lexical minima/maxima. Both deferred cases subsequently passed.
limitations: Selected route subsets near stated city centres, with up to two candidates per mode; city-wide completeness and timetable realism are unverified.
Source structure rejections remain explicit; 101 repair cases supply ordered PTv2 stop members, point positions and labelled placeholders for missing names.
Overture infrastructure cases use explicitly defined audit bus services on actual road segments. Public transport routes and stopping order are supplied by the caller.
The HSL untimed cases deliberately discard source offsets to inspect mode defaults. Adopted speeds remain provisional assumptions.
Snapshots and full logs remain in local temporary storage and are not redistributed.
